value: Source: updated November 2026 Investment and Partnership Opportunities document and Investment and Partnership Overview presentation, with management’s subsequent clarification. IRR wording and proceeds bands are management-stated illustrative scenarios, not independently verified or recalculated. Review the current opportunity-specific financial model during due diligence.

Each scenario starts with an illustrative USD 100,000 allocation. Net proceeds (total net receipts) include capital recovery after modeled costs and commissions; net gain deducts the initial allocation once. Figures cover the stated horizon, are before participant-specific taxes and are not guaranteed.
